evidence.text: Three Days of the Condor -LRB- stylized on the poster art as 3 Days of the Condor -RRB- is a 1975 American political thriller film directed by Sydney Pollack and starring Robert Redford , Faye Dunaway , Cliff Robertson , and Max von Sydow .
The story is a suspense drama set in contemporary Washington , D.C. , and is considerably different from the 1975 film version , Three Days of the Condor .
The screenplay by Lorenzo Semple Jr. and David Rayfiel was adapted from the 1974 novel Six Days of the Condor by James Grady .
Six Days of the Condor is a thriller novel by American author James Grady , first published in 1974 by W.W. Norton .
